title: Metrics monitoring
summary: Collect time series from a large fleet, store them, and evaluate alerts.
functional: Scrape or receive metrics from every host
Evaluate alert rules every few seconds
non_functional: No data loss during a single node failure
Queries over the last hour return in under a second

hosts.why: Machines and containers in the fleet.

metrics_per_host.why: Series per host across system and application metrics.

bytes_per_sample.why: Gorilla-style compression of timestamp and value.

memory_per_series.why: In-memory head block, labels and index per active series.

retention_days.why: Raw samples kept for a month; older data is downsampled.

derived.name: storage_total
derived.label: Storage for the retention period, with replicas
